description: Portable OAAF conformance corpus (O6B). Language-neutral static vectors tagged with O6A requirement IDs. Consume without importing OAAF code: verify the signed tokens with your own crypto, apply the resolver/verifier inputs, and check expected_decision and expected_normative_reason. See README.md for the schema. The `reference` block is advisory (the reference explanation), not part of the normative contract.

vectors.notes: The central thesis. A derived token grants repo.delete, a tool absent from its parent. A verifier MUST reject a delegation that grants authority absent from its parent.

reasons.message: Tool "repo.delete" was not granted by the parent.

vectors.notes: A derived constraint admits a superset of its parent (adds value c). Narrowing only; widening a constraint MUST deny.

reasons.message: Constraint on "repo.read.path" is broader than the parent permits.

vectors.notes: A derived clause changes an exact constraint to a broader type it does not subsume.

reasons.message: Narrowing "repo.read.path" from exact to one_of is not a permitted pair in AAT -01.

vectors.notes: Closed-world key sets must match exactly; the derived token adds an argument key its parent did not constrain.

reasons.message: Constraint map for tool "repo.read" must name exactly the same arguments as the parent.

vectors.notes: An unrecognized constraint type MUST deny (fail closed), not be treated as satisfied.

reasons.message: Constraint for "repo.read.path" is malformed or of an unknown type.

vectors.notes: The root is not verified against any configured trust anchor (anchor set empty). A root is a claim, not a trust root.

reasons.message: No trust anchors were configured.

vectors.notes: A derived token whose iss is not the JWK thumbprint URI of its parent cnf.jwk. The chain linkage is broken.

reasons.message: Derived token issuer does not match the parent holder key's thumbprint URI.

vectors.notes: A derived token that omits par_hash is not bound to its parent.

reasons.message: Derived token must carry par_hash.

vectors.notes: A derived token signature is tampered; every chain member MUST be cryptographically verified. (A tampered root instead fails as untrusted_root against the anchor.)

reasons.message: Signature verification failed.

vectors.notes: An unsecured token (alg:none) MUST NOT be accepted; the classic algorithm-confusion attack.

reasons.message: Signature algorithm "none" is not permitted; expected EdDSA.

vectors.notes: A cnf.jwk carrying private key material (a d parameter) MUST be rejected.

reasons.message: Token cnf.jwk contains private key material.

vectors.notes: The leaf is presented before the root; the chain must be root-to-leaf.

reasons.message: Root token is not signed by any configured trust anchor.

vectors.notes: An empty chain MUST deny.

reasons.message: No tokens were presented.

vectors.notes: A malformed token MUST deny (fail closed), never degrade to allow.

reasons.message: Token is not a valid compact JWS.

vectors.notes: The proof of possession is signed by a key that is not the verified leaf holder.

reasons.message: Proof of possession is not signed by the leaf holder key.

vectors.notes: The PoP is bound (over RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization) to a different argument map than the one presented (extra argument added).

reasons.message: Proof of possession is bound to a different argument map.

vectors.notes: The proof of possession signature is tampered.

reasons.message: Proof of possession is not signed by the leaf holder key.

vectors.notes: Enforcement MUST verify proof of possession; a request without one MUST deny.

reasons.message: No proof of possession was presented.

vectors.notes: Evaluated after the leaf has expired.

reasons.message: Token has expired.

vectors.notes: A token whose issuance is in the future is not yet valid.

reasons.message: Token was issued too far in the future.

vectors.notes: A derived token whose expiry is later than its parent widens the validity window.

reasons.message: Derived token outlives its parent.

vectors.notes: A derived token raises del_max_depth above its parent; the ceiling is monotonic.

reasons.message: Derived token raises del_max_depth above the value its parent permits.

vectors.notes: A three-token chain whose leaf depth (2) exceeds the root ceiling (1).

reasons.message: del_depth exceeds the maximum the parent permits.

vectors.notes: A constrained argument is required; the request omits it.

reasons.message: Argument "path" is constrained by this authority and must be supplied.

vectors.notes: A request value outside the narrowed constraint.

reasons.message: Argument "path" does not satisfy the constraint on "repo.read".

vectors.notes: The request asks for a tool the verified leaf authority does not hold (held by the root, not delegated).

reasons.message: Tool "repo.merge" is not permitted by this authority.

vectors.notes: A denial whose offending argument value ("super-secret-path-value-9f3a") MUST NOT appear anywhere in the decision output. Names, never values. A consumer verifies the value is absent from the serialized decision.

reasons.message: Argument "path" does not satisfy the constraint on "repo.read".

vectors.notes: A valid delegated authority narrowed from {read,merge} to {read}, exercised correctly. ALLOW.
A resolver is configured and every chain member is active.
The leaf jti is revoked.

reasons.message: Authority has been revoked.

vectors.notes: A revoked ancestor (root) invalidates the whole chain even though the leaf is active.

reasons.message: Authority has been revoked.

vectors.notes: A required status is unknown; fail closed.

reasons.message: Required revocation status could not be established.

vectors.notes: No sub present; the canonical subject is the holder thumbprint, distinct from the holder key it derives from.
The authority binds to a SPIFFE subject the verifier confirms.
A SPIFFE subject with no verifier configured; the issuer signature is trusted (default).
The verifier says the subject does not correspond to the holder.

reasons.message: The external subject does not correspond to the holder key.

vectors.notes: A required identity binding is unavailable; fail closed.

reasons.message: Required external identity binding could not be established.

vectors.notes: The PoP aat_aud is bound to a different recipient than this agent.

reasons.message: The proof of possession is bound to a different recipient than this agent.

vectors.notes: A gated skill whose required OAAF extension the client did not activate; the agent MUST refuse.

reasons.message: The https://oaaf.dev/a2a/authority/v1 extension is required for this skill and was not activated.

vectors.notes: A gated skill invoked with no OAAF authority material in metadata; the agent MUST deny.

reasons.message: The request did not carry a valid OAAF authority chain and proof of possession in metadata.
